integrity: The proof is unbounded and exhausts prime squares and products of two distinct primes. The semiprime condition is reduced exactly to \(p+q\mid pq+1\), then to \(p+q\mid p^2-1\), and finally to a unique quotient factorization. Finite computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only the exact layer \(\Omega(n)=2\). It does not classify integers with at least three prime factors counted with multiplicity and makes no infinitude claim for the prime pairs generated by the parametrization.
title: Exact semiprime fibers for a sum–difference totient divisibility
